name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, IKIO Lighting Ltd manufactures and sells LED Lighting[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IKIOLS is an ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) that designs, develops, manufactures and supplies products 
(mainly LED lighting). It has a product offering of over 1,000 SKUs

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 13.8% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 4.25% of profits over last 3 years
